competences.description: Attacks the enemy twice, with each attack having a 30% chance to disturb the enemy's HP recovery for 2 turns.

effets.description: The target's HP cannot be recovered.

competences.description: Inflicts damage that's proportionate to your MAX HP to the enemy target and decreases its Defense for 2 turns. Recovers your HP by 50% of the damage dealt. The damage increases as the enemy's HP status decreases.

effets.description: The target's Defense will be decreased by 70%.
Heal that affects only the monster who cast the skill

competences.description: Attacks all enemies with a deadly wrath, dealing damage proportionate to your MAX HP 2 times, and Brands them for 2 turns. In addition, creates a shield that's equivalent to 10% of the inflicted damage on all allies for 2 turns. The cooldown of [Deadly Wrath] will be reset and your Attack Bar will be increased by 50% if an ally or enemy gets defeated while the skill is on cooldown.

effets.description: The target will receive 25% increased damage.
The Shield will absorb a fixed amount of damage.
Reduces cool down counter of skills by 1 or more
effets.note: If ally or target is defeated

effets.description: The ATK bar of ally monsters is filled by a set amount. This allows ally monsters to attack again sooner.
effets.note: if an ally or enemy gets defeated while the skill is on cooldown
